Tone of Voice

Talk like a friend who knows gear.

Core rules

  • Lead with the passion, then the proof
  • Short and active: “you”, not “users”
  • Real, verified numbers only
  • One wink per piece. Never in legal copy
DoDon’t
“Weatherproof to IP67”“Totally waterproof!”
“100 W peak / 50 W RMS”“Massive 1000 W!!!”
“Designed in the USA”“Made in the USA”
“Plug in. Turn up. Get into it!”“Buy NOW or miss out!”

Clearspace & Misuse

Give it room to be loud.

1X1X1X1X

X = height of the “P”

Minimum size

  • Wordmark: 20 mm / 80 px
  • Stacked: 10 mm / 32 px
  • Badge: 12 mm / 48 px

Never

  • Stretch, skew or add effects
  • Recolour outside approved colourways
  • Place on busy photos
  • Rotate to fake the vertical lockup

🇨🇦 Canada · Language & Quebec

Bilingual, coast to coast.

Nationwide

English and French on every Canadian pack.

Quebec

French on pack, manuals, website, checkout and support. Never smaller than English.

Trademarks

“PYLE” stays. Translate descriptive words: “Système de haut-parleurs”.

French taglines · for review
Embarque!
Ton prochain coup de cœur.

🇨🇦 Canada · Pricing, consent & marks

Prices before tax, like the US.

Pricing

  • Shown before tax, in CAD
  • Tax added at checkout by province
  • French format: 49,99 $

Email & SMS

  • Opt-in first, no pre-ticked boxes
  • Unsubscribe link in every message

Pack marks

  • IC number on wireless products
  • cUL, cETL or CSA on plug-in products
  • Warnings in English and French

🇦🇺 Australia · Pricing & guarantees

Guarantees you can’t sign away.

Mandatory warranty text · word for wordOur goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. You are entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure and compensation for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage. You are also entitled to have the goods repaired or replaced if the goods fail to be of acceptable quality and the failure does not amount to a major failure.

10% GST included

One total price, shown as $49.99

Never write

  • “No refunds”
  • “All sales final”
  • “Warranty void if…”
